summary: Caches recent frames of POP data in GPU memory and outputs a selected cached frame by Output Index. Cache Select POP and Cache Blend POP can read the held frames for multi-frame selection and blends.

key_params.name: activepulse
key_params.note: Capture one snapshot while otherwise inactive

key_params.name: alwayscook
key_params.note: Force the cache to cook every frame

key_params.name: stepunit
key_params.note: Step size expressed in seconds or frames

key_params.name: outputindex
key_params.note: 0 for current cached frame; negative values for older cached frames

key_params.name: outputindexunit
key_params.note: Output index expressed as seconds, frames, or raw cache index

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Clear and hold cache while on

key_concepts: Stores recent POP snapshots in uncompressed GPU memory up to Cache Size.
Output Index selects cached history where 0 is the current snapshot and negative values address older snapshots.
Step Size spaces snapshots over time, extending history duration without storing every frame.
Cache Select POP and Cache Blend POP can reference the held snapshots for explicit retrieval or multi-frame blends.
common_gotchas: Cached POP data is held uncompressed in GPU memory; large geometry and long cache sizes can be expensive.
The cache is cleared when the file restarts; cached frames are not saved into the .toe or .tox.
Dropped frames make cache time less regular; Trail POP handles missing frame time differently via Age.
